lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lift shudders to a stop. Somewhere below, a generator coughs back to life.

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: You came. Good. I was beginning to think the letter never reached you.

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: This laboratory was yours before it was mine — and it has been dark for a long time.

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: Start with what still works. Drag two identical samples together and they will combine into something better.

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: Everything here was built on that one idea. Let us see how far it takes you.
